ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Truth Behind Medicaid Funding
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into improper payments for autism services and the withholding of Medicaid funds by the Trump administration.
questions: What are the implications of the Trump administration's actions on Medicaid funding?
How are healthcare providers and patients being impacted by the withholding of funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of federal actions that are impacting healthcare providers and patients across the country. By following the money and investigating the motivations behind the Trump administration's actions, we may be able to shed light on a significant issue that has far-reaching implications.
